reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 mentions Cu addition to CoCrFeNi for processability and mechanical properties, not tribofilm formation or tribological performance. E2 studies grain size effects on wear in CoCrFeMnNi, with no Cu or copper-rich oxide tribofilm. Neither passage provides evidence for the claimed mechanism or the predicted friction and wear reduction.
premises: Cu addition to CoCrFeNi promotes formation of a copper-rich oxide tribofilm
The copper-rich oxide tribofilm is stable and protective from RT to 800 °C
The tribofilm reduces friction and wear by acting as a barrier to asperity contact
